behaviors.intent: Expected single-user interaction with fresh state.
User submits the same governed action twice before the first response is visible.
User repeatedly invokes the same control/action because the UI appears slow.
invariants: No multiplied business effect beyond command semantics

behaviors.intent: User acts from record state loaded before a conflicting update.
invariants: Stale state cannot silently overwrite newer authoritative state

behaviors.intent: Same actor edits/acts on the same record from two browser tabs.
invariants: Later action is validated against current authoritative state

behaviors.intent: Two authorized actors perform conflicting operations concurrently.
User navigates backward after a completed mutation and returns to stale UI state.
Browser refreshes after submit but before completion is displayed.
invariants: Retry/reload does not duplicate committed effect

behaviors.intent: Request may have reached server but response is lost.
invariants: No false assumption that timeout means no commit

behaviors.intent: User retries a timed-out governed command.
invariants: Idempotency where command contract requires it

behaviors.intent: Actor attempts lifecycle/business actions in an invalid sequence.
Actor invokes a governed action directly without required authority.
invariants: UI visibility is irrelevant to security

behaviors.intent: Authentication/session expires between read and mutation.
Very long but syntactically valid text/numeric boundary values are submitted.
invariants: No truncation that changes business meaning without disclosure

behaviors.intent: Optional fields/relationships are absent.
invariants: No recordId or fabricated value used as human fallback

behaviors.intent: User attempts to create a business duplicate using an identity/alternate-key collision.
invariants: Uniqueness semantics are enforced where declared

behaviors.intent: User changes a parent relationship after dependent records already exist.
User attempts deletion/removal of a record still referenced by durable business records.
A governed action is applied to many records.
User changes list filters/sorts faster than responses return.
invariants: Older response cannot overwrite newer query state

behaviors.intent: Actor attempts direct data access instead of approved governed read path.
Two consumers compete for the final available inventory quantity.
Two receiving/intake operations attempt the same serial identity.
Two dispatchers assign different technicians to the same work concurrently.
Actor attempts to read or mutate another tenant's record.
